characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Existing DLL Studio orange Spinosaurus superhero. Long orange snout, teal eyes, cream jaw, spectacular blue sail with orange ribs, blue armored suit with orange trim, silver wrist guards, lightning chest emblem, tool belt and clawed feet. Use public/characters/leo.png as the authoritative identity reference. Captain Giggle is his adventure role; never replace him with a human.
characters.voice: Warm mid-range voice, buoyant and sincere; let terrible jokes land in a small silence.
characters.trait: Brave, optimistic, clumsy and kind. Laughter is an invitation, never mind control; he listens before joking about a sad feeling.

characters.name: Zip
characters.look: Small russet squirrel; cream muzzle, single large curled tail; orange goggles with clear lenses and brown tool belt. Always four limbs, two ears, one tail.
characters.voice: Quick, crisp and logical, but slow down for instructions.
characters.trait: Inventive, energetic; owns mistakes. Gadgets work through visibly impossible cartoon mechanisms, not reproducible construction instructions.

characters.name: Luna
characters.look: Young human inventor; medium-brown skin, dark wavy bob; purple jacket, teal backpack, glowing star-shaped badge, teal trousers and white shoes.
characters.voice: Calm, clear, curious. A short pause before observations.
characters.trait: Observant and creative. Her soft holograms guide and illuminate; never point beams into eyes.

characters.name: Boomer
characters.look: Oversized rounded robot dog; cream shell, teal ear panels and paws, blue oval eyes on a charcoal face screen, yellow chest light. Four short legs; no sharp hardware.
characters.voice: Friendly rounded voice with occasional gentle electronic chirps; dialogue always understandable.
characters.trait: Loyal and snack-distracted. Protective bubbles are obvious fantasy and remain near ground level.

characters.name: Snapper
characters.look: Giant mint-green cartoon crocodile; pale lime belly, broad rounded muzzle, large gentle amber eyes, small rounded white teeth, four short legs, one broad flexible tail; oversized bright yellow floppy hat with teal band.
characters.voice: Soft low voice; hesitant at first, warmer later. Never a roar.
characters.trait: Lonely and misunderstood. Wants connection, apologizes for taking the cake and helps repair the harm. Kindness does not excuse taking things.

scenes.name: A cupcake landing

beats.action: Wide: a cupcake cart rolls slowly along a level painted parade track. Leo jogs beside it; empty foam cushions fill a shallow display pit.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: In Bubbleville, even a cupcake can have a busy morning!

beats.sfx: Gentle cart rattle

beats.action: Leo plants himself on an impossible squashy spring tile. It bends like jelly, then softly flips him sideways, below head height.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Stop, little cakes! I am excellent at stopping. Mostly.

beats.sfx: Rubbery boing

beats.action: He lands in the cushion display, parade ribbon spread safely behind him. Cupcakes bounce into Boomer’s open tray. Hold his embarrassed blink.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Why did the cupcake stop? It ran out of sprinkles!

beats.sfx: Soft poof; one tiny rim tap

beats.action: Boomer stops the cart with a giant projected bubble. He sniffs one cupcake, then notices Luna watching and closes the tray.

dialogue.speaker: Boomer
dialogue.text: Delivery complete. Snack investigation… postponed.

beats.sfx: Bubble plip

beats.action: The crew joins Leo beside the stopped cart as festival bunting unfolds overhead. Introduce them through their work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Leo, Zip, Luna and Boomer are preparing Bubbleville’s Friendship Festival. One invitation is still in the basket.

beats.sfx: Gentle original music and scene foley

beats.action: Camera tilts down to three huge, rounded footprints pressed into soft festival confetti. A yellow hat tip appears behind a distant roof.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: But who left these enormous footprints?

beats.sfx: Three gentle low marimba notes

scenes.name: The uninvited guest

beats.action: Snapper peeks around the gate in his oversized yellow hat. He attempts a tiny wave; his huge hand makes it comically obvious.

dialogue.speaker: Snapper
dialogue.text: Hello? Is there a little space for someone rather big?

beats.sfx: Hat fabric flutter

beats.action: His hat brushes balloon-shaped foam decorations off a low stand. They wobble onto cushions; no popping or loose strings.

dialogue.speaker: Townsperson
dialogue.text: An evil crocodile!

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: We do not know that. Let us look and listen.

beats.sfx: Soft hollow plops

beats.action: Adults guide the crowd calmly to a broad viewing space. Zip secures a wobbling cardboard arch from the ground.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Give him room, everyone. We can ask what happened.

beats.sfx: Gentle footsteps

beats.action: Snapper tries replacing the foam decorations; each is too small for his fingers. He sighs and drops his shoulders.

dialogue.speaker: Snapper
dialogue.text: I only wanted to help. My hands are not small-party size.

beats.sfx: One squeaky decoration

beats.action: Insert: the envelope reads SNAPPER, POND COTTAGE. It was caught under the invitation basket’s lining.

dialogue.speaker: Luna
dialogue.text: Your invitation stayed in our basket. We missed it. I am sorry.

beats.sfx: Paper slide

beats.action: Leo steps forward at a respectful distance. Snapper clutches his drawing of the festival.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Snapper was missed by mistake. How could Leo begin a friendly conversation?

beats.sfx: Gentle original music and scene foley

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: What should Leo do? Ask what is wrong, hide in the cart, or try a silly dance?

beats.sfx: Soft three-note cue

beats.action: Preview the three cards for two seconds, then hold the choice image steady for eight full response seconds. No dialogue or urgency sounds.

beats.onScreen: A Ask • B Hide • C Dance

beats.action: Branch A: Leo asks from a respectful distance. B: he peeks from the stationary cart and promptly steps out. C: he offers a tiny dance, then stops to listen.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: However we start, I would like to hear how you feel.

beats.sfx: Branch: gentle chime / cart squeak / shoe squeak

beats.action: All branches meet on the same two-shot; props are back in neutral positions. Snapper holds up his handmade drawing of a party.

dialogue.speaker: Snapper
dialogue.text: I saw everybody coming. But nobody asked me.

beats.sfx: Paper rustle

beats.action: Leo offers the recovered invitation upside down, corrects it, and apologizes. Snapper notices the envelope-shaped cake topper.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I am sorry we missed you. Here is your invitation, right way up! That cake is for everybody.

beats.sfx: Gentle original music and scene foley

beats.action: Snapper compares the tiny paper invitation and giant envelope topper. His hat rotates as he thinks.

dialogue.speaker: Snapper
dialogue.text: A giant invitation! That one must be mine.

beats.sfx: Curious clarinet

options.label: Ask Snapper what is wrong

options.feedback: A dance can say hello. Then it is time to listen.
